name: Folate/direct/folate route
description: Folate-dependent GAR formylation, direct AIR carboxylation, and folate-dependent AICAR formylation.

name: Folate/direct/formate route
description: Folate-dependent GAR formylation, direct AIR carboxylation, and formate-dependent AICAR formylation.

name: Folate/two-step/folate route
description: Folate-dependent GAR formylation, two-step AIR carboxylation, and folate-dependent AICAR formylation.

name: Folate/two-step/formate route
description: Folate-dependent GAR formylation, two-step AIR carboxylation, and formate-dependent AICAR formylation.

name: Formate/direct/folate route
description: Formate-dependent GAR formylation, direct AIR carboxylation, and folate-dependent AICAR formylation.

name: Formate/direct/formate route
description: Formate-dependent GAR formylation, direct AIR carboxylation, and formate-dependent AICAR formylation.

name: Formate/two-step/folate route
description: Formate-dependent GAR formylation, two-step AIR carboxylation, and folate-dependent AICAR formylation.

name: Formate/two-step/formate route
description: Formate-dependent GAR formylation, two-step AIR carboxylation, and formate-dependent AICAR formylation.

name: Adenylosuccinate route
description: IMP to AMP through adenylosuccinate synthase and adenylosuccinate lyase.

name: XMP route
description: IMP to GMP through IMP dehydrogenase and glutamine-dependent GMP synthase.

name: Fumarate-dependent DHODH route
description: De novo UMP biosynthesis using fumarate-dependent dihydroorotate oxidation.

name: NAD-dependent DHODH route
description: De novo UMP biosynthesis using NAD-dependent dihydroorotate oxidation.

name: Quinone-dependent DHODH route
description: De novo UMP biosynthesis using quinone-dependent dihydroorotate oxidation.

name: Glutamine-dependent CTP synthase route
description: UTP to CTP through the complete glutamine-dependent CTP synthase reaction.

name: Phosphorylated serine route
description: 3-phosphoglycerate oxidation, transamination and dephosphorylation to L-serine.

name: Serine hydroxymethyltransferase route
description: Folate-dependent removal of the serine hydroxymethyl group to give glycine.

name: Aspartate kinase route
description: Aspartate phosphorylation followed by NADPH-dependent reduction to the 4-semialdehyde.

name: NAD-dependent homoserine dehydrogenase route
description: Reduction of L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde to L-homoserine using NADH.

name: NADP-dependent homoserine dehydrogenase route
description: Reduction of L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde to L-homoserine using NADPH.

name: Homoserine kinase route
description: Homoserine phosphorylation followed by threonine synthase.

name: Succinyl/transsulfuration/cobalamin route
description: O-succinylhomoserine transsulfuration with cobalamin-dependent methionine synthase.

name: Succinyl/transsulfuration/cobalamin-independent route
description: O-succinylhomoserine transsulfuration with cobalamin-independent methionine synthase.

name: Acetyl/transsulfuration/cobalamin route
description: O-acetylhomoserine transsulfuration with cobalamin-dependent methionine synthase.

name: Acetyl/transsulfuration/cobalamin-independent route
description: O-acetylhomoserine transsulfuration with cobalamin-independent methionine synthase.

name: Phospho/transsulfuration/cobalamin route
description: Plant O-phosphohomoserine transsulfuration with cobalamin-dependent methionine synthase.

name: Phospho/transsulfuration/cobalamin-independent route
description: Plant O-phosphohomoserine transsulfuration with cobalamin-independent methionine synthase.

name: Succinyl/sulfhydrylation/cobalamin route
description: Direct sulfide incorporation into O-succinylhomoserine with cobalamin-dependent methionine synthase.

name: Succinyl/sulfhydrylation/cobalamin-independent route
description: Direct sulfide incorporation into O-succinylhomoserine with cobalamin-independent methionine synthase.

name: Acetyl/sulfhydrylation/cobalamin route
description: Direct sulfide incorporation into O-acetylhomoserine with cobalamin-dependent methionine synthase.

name: Acetyl/sulfhydrylation/cobalamin-independent route
description: Direct sulfide incorporation into O-acetylhomoserine with cobalamin-independent methionine synthase.

name: O-acetylserine sulfhydrylation route
description: Serine acetylation followed by sulfide incorporation.

name: Serine-dependent reverse transsulfuration route
description: Cystathionine beta-synthase acting on L-serine, then cystathionine gamma-lyase.

name: O-acetylserine-dependent reverse transsulfuration route
description: Serine acetylation, cystathionine beta-synthase acting on O-acetyl-L-serine, then cystathionine gamma-lyase.

name: Xylose isomerase route
description: Isomerisation to D-xylulose and phosphorylation to D-xylulose 5-phosphate.

name: L-arabinose isomerase route
description: Isomerisation to L-ribulose, phosphorylation, and epimerisation to D-xylulose 5-phosphate.

name: L-fucose isomerase route
description: Isomerisation to L-fuculose, phosphorylation, and aldol cleavage.

name: L-rhamnose isomerase route
description: Isomerisation to L-rhamnulose, phosphorylation, and aldol cleavage.

name: Leloir route
description: Mutarotation, galactokinase, uridylyltransferase, and UDP-glucose regeneration.

name: N-acetylglucosamine kinase route
description: Phosphorylation, deacetylation, and deamination to fructose 6-phosphate.

name: N-acetylneuraminate lyase route
description: Lyase cleavage to N-acetylmannosamine, phosphorylation, epimerisation, deacetylation, and deamination.

name: Galacturonate isomerase route
description: Isomerisation, reduction, dehydration, phosphorylation, and aldol cleavage.

name: Glucuronate isomerase route
description: Isomerisation, reduction, dehydration, phosphorylation, and aldol cleavage.

name: ABC importer route
description: ATP-driven translocation by a periplasmic-binding-protein-dependent importer.

name: ABC importer route
description: ATP-driven translocation by a periplasmic-binding-protein-dependent importer.

name: Endo-xylanase and beta-xylosidase route
description: Backbone endohydrolysis then exo-acting release of D-xylose, with acetyl de-blocking as accessory chemistry.

name: Arabinofuranosidase route
description: Hydrolysis of alpha-L-arabinofuranosyl side chains.

name: Alpha-amylase and alpha-glucosidase route
description: Backbone endohydrolysis then exo-acting release of D-glucose, with alpha-1,6 debranching as accessory chemistry.

name: M9 microbial collagenase route
description: Direct cleavage of the collagen triple helix by a secreted family M9 collagenase.
